descriptions.news_1: In 2013, I was recognized with an award honoring my commitment to both academic excellence and athletic achievement.
descriptions.news_2: I was awarded second place in the FEDA Week 2012/2013 national student competition, themed 'Bridge of the Future,' competing against more than 60 universities across Egypt.
descriptions.news_3: I graduated as the top-ranked student with a Bachelor's degree in Architectural Engineering and Urban Design from Future University in Egypt after completing a five-year program.
descriptions.news_4: I started a Research and Development internship at Konligo in Brussels, where I contributed to the computational design and exploration of deployable structural systems.
descriptions.news_5: As part of a team, I won a project design competition for a conceptual proposal for Prison de Saint-Gilles 2030 in Brussels within a VUB course (Class of 2022).
descriptions.news_6: I obtained my Master’s degree through the BRUFACE integrated program, a joint initiative between Vrije Universiteit Brussel (VUB) and Université libre de Bruxelles (ULB).
descriptions.news_7: I started my PhD research position in Architectural Engineering at VUB, working under the supervision of Niels De Temmerman, Tine Tysmans, and Lars De Laet.
descriptions.news_8: I conducted a workshop on modular structures and scissor structures as part of the Wetenschapsshow Ingenieurswetenschappen at Vrije Universiteit Brussel (VUB) in 2023.
descriptions.news_9: I presented my research at a joint seminar organized by TU Delft and Vrije Universiteit Brussel (VUB), contributing to inter-university collaboration.
descriptions.news_10: I attended and presented my research at the Realty Belgium Real Estate Summit 2022, held at Tour & Taxis in Brussels.
descriptions.news_11: I participated in an academic visit to the Singapore-ETH Centre in 2023 as part of a research exchange within the Future Cities Lab Global programme.
descriptions.news_12: I presented my research at the IASS Annual Symposium 2023 in Melbourne, focusing on the integration of design and fabrication.
descriptions.news_13: I delivered a guest lecture in the Architectural Engineering program at Future University in Egypt, focusing on innovative structural techniques and contemporary design approaches.
descriptions.news_14: In 2024, I participated in the exhibition of architectural engineering student work at the VUB Difference Day event in Brussels, showcasing projects developed within the Parametric Design and Transformable Structures course.
descriptions.news_15: I presented my research at the IASS Annual Symposium 2024 at ETH Zurich, contributing to discussions on redefining the art of structural design.
descriptions.news_16: I presented my research at the IASS Annual Symposium 2025 in Mexico City, exploring how scissor systems can expand scaffolding applications.
descriptions.news_17: I participated in a series of collaboration meetings involving the Horse Festival, the VUB Department of Architecture, and Asiat Park to explore future collaborations between VUB and Asiat Park.
descriptions.news_18: I participated in a podcast interview with Olivia Gambelin, author of Responsible AI, where we discussed research, creativity, problem-solving, and the role of doubt in the learning process.
descriptions.news_19: In 2026, I will be conducting a workshop at the IASS Conference in Torino, sharing insights from my research and design work with Niels De Temmerman and Lars De Laet.
descriptions.news_20: I was invited to deliver a guest lecture titled 'Architecture Beyond Limits: Structural Innovation in Extreme Environments' in Cairo in March 2026.
descriptions.news_21: I was a visiting researcher at the National Technical University of Athens (NTUA), collaborating with Prof. Charalampos (Charis) Gantes at the Institute of Steel Structures.
descriptions.news_22: I collaborated with DuPont (Corian®) through a contract with the Vrije Universiteit Brussel (VUB) Department of Architecture, together with Lars De Laet, to develop parametrically adjustable systems for custom design applications.
descriptions.news_23: I was featured in an interview as an international alumnus in the Vrije Universiteit Brussel (VUB) Architecture Yearbook, where I reflected on my academic journey, design experiences, and future aspirations.
descriptions.news_24: I was assigned by the Egyptian Karate Federation to serve as head organizer of a 60-member team for the international karate competition (Sharm El-Sheikh Open - WKF Karate Premier League), held from 26/2 to 2/3/2015.
descriptions.news_25: I was appointed by Al Ahly Sporting Club to serve as a member of the Executive Organizing Committee for the Al Ahly International Karate Open Championship, held at Al Ahly Club from 28–31 January 2016.
